'''Keith Stephanson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Washington State Championship]] on 22 April 2000 with Droid insert manip deck (Droid Workshop start), according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d609">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-25-washington-statesd609/ washington-states], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 25 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-25-washington-statesd609/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
